description: Maximum price for a second property (cottage, rental or second home) while keeping your current home: combined TDS across both properties, subject-property GDS, minimum down payment (20% unless you'll live in it), optional rental income add-back.

annualIncome.description: Household gross annual income in CAD

borrowedEquityAmount.description: HELOC/equity borrowed for this purchase, in CAD

condoFees.description: Second property's monthly condo fees (50% counted)

downPayment.description: Down payment in CAD, or percent if downPaymentMode='percent'

downPaymentMode.description: downPayment as dollars or percent of price

intent.description: Cottage/vacation, rental/investment, or second personal home

interestRatePct.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 4.49

otherDebts.description: Other monthly debt payments (cards, car, loans)

purchasePrice.description: Second property purchase price in CAD

rentalCreditMode.description: Lender rent treatment: 50% or 80% add-back, or full offset

rentalIncome.description: Expected monthly rent; 0 = no rental income counted

willOccupy.description: Will you live in it part-time? Allows CMHC Second Home (5%+ down). Ignored for rentals.
